Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Isbell
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 415 as introduced would exempt individuals engaged in the production of farm products from payment of any license or fee to a county for the sale of farm products produced by the farmer. This bill could decrease receipts to the various counties by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of any such licensee fees exempted pursuant to this bill.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government

Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Isbell
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/02/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 415 as amended and reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would exempt individuals engaged in the production of farm products from payment of any license or fee to a county for the sale of farm products produced by the farmer, a member of his or her immediate family, or those employed by the farmer. This bill could decrease receipts to the various counties by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of any such licensee fees exempted pursuant to this bill.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Date: 03/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 415 as passed the House of Representatives would exempt individuals engaged in the production of farm products from payment of any license or fee to a county for the sale of farm products produced by the farmer, a member of his or her immediate family, or those employed by the farmer. This bill could decrease receipts to the various counties by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of any such licensee fees exempted pursuant to this bill.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
